title: Version alpha release evidence schema
summary: Alpha release evidence should include a stable schema identifier so bundle validators and future release tooling can reject incompatible evidence instead of inferring shape from kind alone.
expectedFailureModes: Future release tooling accepts an unversioned evidence shape after the envelope changes.
Bundle validation relies on a loose kind field and misses incompatible evidence.
Docs describe evidence contents without naming the schema contract.
humanEscalation: Schema-breaking release evidence changes require human approval once published evidence exists.
nextAction: Add a schema field to alpha release evidence, require it in bundle validation, document the versioned envelope, and update the release evidence regression check.
